detail.longDescription: It seems that no matter where a student looks on the VSU campus anymore, Artificial Intelligence (AI)  looks back at them.  Since the start of the 2026 academic year, there has been a drastic rise in AI-generated advertisements for campus events.  It began first with Housing, showing off an AI-generated infographic on their table at The Happening, then other on-campus organizations followed, like The Rec, NABA, and VSU Council on Staff Affairs.
